name: Oboshiro Hipopo Daiya
original_name: 朧白・ヒポポ・金剛石
source:
A refined young lady, and granddaughter of the village head. Shows extraordinary initiative, always charging ahead and figuring stuff out afterward. Her power to win over others makes her a first-class mood maker.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4838460/HimaNatsu_Of_Churches_Sunflowers_and_Long_Summers/]Steam[/url]]
